cfgtip.h: Server admins: settings files after an update
cfgtip.s.0: Why: each $profile:INDFORGE_*/config.json file is created only when it is missing, and never updated afterwards. After a mod update, a server keeps its old settings.
cfgtip.s.1: With Conflict PvE 2.1.0: after the update, stop the server, delete the config.json of the systems that changed (INDFORGE_Weather, INDFORGE_EnemyHQ, INDFORGE_FireSupport, INDFORGE_AIDoctrine), then restart: the server writes them again with the new settings.
cfgtip.s.2: New folders (INDFORGE_AIBudget, INDFORGE_Movement, INDFORGE_RadioAlerts, INDFORGE_DroneTeam, INDFORGE_NightGear, INDFORGE_MavicLight, INDFORGE_RadarTruck) are created on their own at the first start.
cfgtip.s.3: Careful: deleting a file also erases the settings you changed in it. Write them down first.
cfgtip.next: In preparation, not available yet: automatic update of the settings at server start (new keys added, values never changed moved to the new defaults, your own values kept, a backup copy of the old file).
cfg.aibudget: New in Conflict PvE 2.1.0. Read at each session start. Admin command: #aibudget status | on | off.
cfg.radartruck: New in Conflict PvE 2.1.0: settings of the Radar/Jammer Bigfoot truck.

about.title: About us
about.lead: INDFORGE-Studio is a team of modders and beta testers working on ARMA REFORGER. We create works we hope are as immersive as possible: co-op PvE campaigns against an enemy that thinks, systems for mission makers, configuration packs for the communities we play with, and much more… Basically, this is our wiki, so help yourself, it's free.
about.unit_p: An independent modding studio carefully crafting Arma Reforger mods for release on the Bohemia Interactive Workshop.
about.roster_d: Only names in direct collaboration are listed here; all others are indirect collaborations only, backed solely by an explicit written agreement approving modification.
about.r_valaaks: CTRP team contributor: SAMU equipment in ChercheToi RP - Clothing
about.d.0: On the shoulders of giants. We build on other creators' mods as declared dependencies and credit them on every page. Nothing repacked.
about.d.1: Documented settings. Every server setting ships with its own help text, right next to it in the file.
about.d.2: Tested before release. Changes go through a real dedicated-server test bench and a review before they reach the Workshop.
about.d.3: Readable by players. The enemy cheats less and tells you more: signal lights on drones that change colour when they spot you, radio hints, sirens before a strike.
about.d.4: Respect the licences. Our mods are released under the Arma Public Licence (APL or APL-ND, as stated on each page).

admins.title: Admins
admins.lead: Install a dedicated server, load our mods, set them up from the profile files and drive them with in-game commands. Everything here is generic: no real server, address, port or password.
admins.install_s.0: Install Arma Reforger Server (Steam tool, or SteamCMD with app ID 1874900), or rent a game server from a host.
admins.install_s.1: Write a configuration file, for example server.json (structure below).
admins.install_s.2: Start the server with -config pointing to that file and -profile pointing to a folder it can write to. That folder is what our mods call $profile:.
admins.install_s.3: Add our mods to game.mods: each mod page gives the full block ready to paste, and the scenario ID to put in game.scenarioId.
admins.install_s.4: Start once, stop, then drop our config.json files into the profile folder (section 4) and start again.
admins.json_p: The usual structure of a Reforger dedicated-server configuration. Fill in your own values; ports shown are the documented defaults. Keep passwordAdmin out of any file you share.
admins.json_persist: game.gameProperties.persistence.autoSaveInterval sets the autosave interval (minutes). The persistence block belongs inside gameProperties: at the root or directly in game, the server refuses to start.
admins.scen_p: Value for game.scenarioId. The mods list comes from the mod's own page.
admins.profile_s.0: $profile: is the folder given to the server with -profile. A file named $profile:INDFORGE_Weather/config.json lives in <profile>/INDFORGE_Weather/config.json.
admins.profile_s.1: A missing file is created with its defaults at startup. An existing file is never overwritten: to take a new default, put the reference copy back.
admins.profile_s.2: Every key Name comes with a help key _Name right above it. The mod never reads help keys: they are there for you, and can be deleted.
admins.profile_s.3: Most files are read once at startup: restart the server after a change. Never edit a file while the server writes to it.
admins.profile_s.4: Do not delete a key to "go back to default": the code fallback is not always the shipped value. Copy the original value back instead.
admins.cmds_p: Typed in the in-game chat by a player with the server administrator or session administrator role, or sent through RCON with admin permission. Answers come back in the chat.
admins.cfg_p: Every key of our server files with its shipped value and its help text, read from the reference copies. Help texts are quoted in English, as in the files.
admins.logs_p: Our systems write tagged lines in the server log. Search for these tags to follow what they do:
admins.logs_s.0: INDFORGE enemy HQ: tracks, groups sent, plans, ambushes, strikes, and a summary every 5 minutes.
admins.logs_s.1: INDFORGE AI doctrine: at startup, on weather changes and every 5 minutes.
admins.logs_s.2: INDFORGE generator capture:, INDFORGE generator breach: and INDFORGE fuel truck: base capture.
admins.logs_s.3: INDFORGE hunter size:, INDFORGE drone sight:, INDFORGE patrol trucks:, INDFORGE session: — and, in the next update, INDFORGE weather:, INDFORGE night gear:, INDFORGE drone team:, INDFORGE radio alerts:.
admins.logs_s.4: AI Framework (in development, not released yet): lines starting with [INDF_CombatHeliConfig], [INDF_POIManager], [INDF_MilitaryGarrisonManager], [INDF_CounterAttackDirector] and [INDF_CombatHeliSpawner].
cmd.setrank: Sets a player's rank. Exact in-game name, then the rank name (PRIVATE, CORPORAL, SERGEANT, LIEUTENANT, CAPTAIN, MAJOR…) or its number. The rank is saved across restarts.
cmd.aidoctrine: Shows, reloads, enables or disables the AI doctrine.
cmd.aidoctrine_mod: Multiplies every engagement range by a factor, for some seconds or until switched off, to react to an event without a restart.
cmd.aibudget: AI budget around the players: show its status, switch it on or off.
cmd.enemyhq: Shows the enemy headquarters: tracks, groups, plans.
cmd.enemyhq_here: Sends a fake sighting of yourself to the enemy HQ (as a drone contact and/or a vehicle), for tests.
cmd.enemyhq_rb: Lists the persistent roadblocks, or removes them all.
cmd.enemyhq_strike: Triggers an air strike or a Geran salvo in front of the admin, for tests.
cmd.weather: Weather director: status, force the next episode, hold fog, rain or wind values, resume, play every episode in a row (cycle), lay an ambiance over the current episode (ambiance), switch off or on.
cmd.weather_thunder: Thunder, until the next start: synced to its flash (thundersync), at the speed of sound (soundspeed), rain thunders played by the director with their flash (rainthunder; test sends one). Without on or off: current state.
cmd.nightgear: Night-vision and thermal equipment of the AI: counts and settings.
intel.title: News
intel.lead: What we know of the USSR/FIA command you face in INDFORGE - Conflict PvE and INDFORGE - Forest. Read it before you deploy.
intel.summary_p: The enemy no longer knows where you are by magic. Its headquarters acts on reports: what its drones and patrols actually see. It predicts where you are going, chooses a plan, calls its mortars and adapts to weather and night. Stay unseen and it stays blind.
intel.hq_s.0: Sources. An enemy drone contact, or an enemy group that identifies a player or a player vehicle. Close reports merge into a track: last known position, time, source, on foot or in a vehicle.
intel.hq_s.1: Dispatch. A fresh track gets a group, spawned on a road far from every player. Drone intel brings special forces; a patrol report brings hunters. A spotted vehicle brings an anti-vehicle team.
intel.hq_s.2: Prediction. Two reports give your direction and speed. The group heads where you should be by now, not where you were seen.
intel.hq_s.3: Search. A cold track is searched around its estimated position, on a radius that grows with time, then the group returns.
intel.hq_s.4: Formations. Column on the march, wedge on approach, line on assault and on contact.
intel.hq_s.5: Size. Hunter groups and helicopter paratroopers grow with the number of players nearby.
intel.doctrine_p: Every enemy soldier follows a doctrine level that sets when he opens fire on infantry, from how far, and how he withdraws.
intel.lvl.boot: FIA soldiers, hunters sent on a patrol report
intel.lvl.grunt: Regular USSR and US infantry, squad marksmen
intel.lvl.operator: Spetsnaz, KLMK, recon, special forces, modern US AI
intel.lvl.overwatch: Special-forces snipers and their spotters only
intel.doctrine_s.0: Fire discipline. A group that spots you before you see it holds its fire and closes in.
intel.doctrine_s.1: Tactical withdrawal. Caught off guard, half the group falls back firing while the other half sprints to cover, then they swap, regroup and come back.
intel.doctrine_s.2: Ranges depend on your posture and movement, the weapon, the group size, night and weather. A target that fires loses the benefit of its posture.
intel.fires_s.0: Mortar batteries set up in an enemy base 900 m to 3.5 km from the target, out of towns, with a crew, sentries and a patrol.
intel.fires_s.1: An observer is required: a group leader or a recon drone must see you, and you must stay put long enough. Ranging rounds come first, then fire for effect.
intel.fires_s.2: Counter-battery play: the batteries can be found and destroyed.
intel.drones_p: Enemy drones see you by distance, posture and cover:
intel.drones_s.0: Standing still cuts these ranges by 30 %. Night and weather cut them further.
intel.drones_s.1: Any foliage between you and the drone hides you — even the bush you hide in. Under 15 m, the drone's own test applies.
intel.drones_s.2: A drone that loses you hunts where it last saw you for about two minutes.
intel.drones_s.3: Back-pack jammers stop FPV drones within 50 m.
intel.light_p: A small light under the enemy Mavic tells you what it is doing. Never on an FPV.
intel.light_rf: Fast red blink: guiding a glide bomb
intel.light_o: Orange blink: searching where it lost you
intel.plans_p: For each track, the HQ scores what it knows — on foot or in a vehicle, still or moving, grouped players, inside a base, night, fog, rain, drones available, mortars, recent losses — then picks a plan:
intel.plan.0: L-shaped attack — one group fixes you at 200 m, a second flanks at 90°, both assault together.
intel.plan.1: Hammer and anvil — one group blocks the road ahead of a moving target, the other pushes.
intel.plan.2: Mortar first — the battery strikes, the group waits out of the danger zone, then assaults.
intel.plan.3: Infiltration — special forces creep in close, at night or in fog.
intel.plan.4: Feint — one group shows itself and attacks, the second waits on another axis.
intel.plan.5: Harassment — a sniper team on high ground plus the mortar, against a strong position.
intel.plans_esc: Escalation. Every group you wipe out nearby makes the next ones bigger and sharper, and favours the mortar.
intel.ambush_s.0: The HQ follows the road ahead of your vehicle and sets a kill zone 400 to 600 m further, on the high side.
intel.ambush_s.1: Nine variants: lone AT team, L-shaped, mines and fire, the trap (road closed behind you), the bait (a wreck on the road), FPV corridor, close night ambush, long-range hunter on a crest, and a pre-registered mortar strike at a junction.
intel.ambush_s.2: Persistent roadblocks appear on the paved roads you use most, and move every couple of days.
intel.ambush_s.3: Nobody fires before you enter the zone: the first rocket, then everyone.
intel.air_s.0: Glide bomb on players on foot that a Mavic keeps in sight — its red light blinks fast. Shoot the drone or break its view.
intel.air_s.1: Cruise missile on a base you just took from the enemy. The base siren sounds before impact.
intel.air_s.2: Su-57 reconnaissance passes can report you to the HQ.
intel.air_s.3: Geran raids from launch trucks parked on roads kilometres away. Kill the truck or its driver and the raid stops.
intel.air_s.4: Never on a faction's main base, never danger-close to enemy soldiers, never when the weather grounds aircraft.
intel.weather_s.0: 21 credible episodes, by day and by night, in sequence: clear, still night, night mist, low stratus, hot haze, fair, breezy, clearing, cloudy, overcast, dawn mist, mist, grey front, drizzle, showers, rain, dry thunder, thunderstorm, night storm, storm tail, fog banks — with smooth transitions.
intel.weather_s.1: Drones are grounded from 10 m/s of wind, heavy rain or thick fog; helicopter drops and waves from 14 m/s; paratroopers from 8 m/s.
intel.weather_s.2: Fog and rain shorten what mortar observers can see. Thermal sights see through light fog.
intel.night_s.0: Some soldiers get night-vision goggles — more often snipers and special forces, less often by day.
intel.night_s.1: What a soldier sees comes from what he carries: naked eye, night vision or thermal scope. Some enemy drones carry a thermal camera.
intel.radio_p: Short radio-style hints reach the players concerned: drone overhead, interception group on the way, mortar, Geran, missile, jet, ambush, friendly fighters chasing the jet, radar contact on the jet, the enemy triangulating your radar or jammer, emitter located. Never the enemy's exact position.
intel.base_s.0: Standing in the zone no longer takes a generator base: repair the generator with a wrench, then fill it with 18 L of fuel while the siren sounds. Radio contact with your HQ is required.
intel.base_s.1: About 30 s after you take it, the nearest enemy soldier walks to the generator to sabotage it (8 s). Kill him first.
intel.base_s.2: Wall the generator in with HESCO and a breacher lays demolition charges on the closest wall: 20 s fuse, kill him or defuse.
intel.guide_s.0: Stay spread out: enemy rocket launchers also fire at infantry.
intel.guide_s.1: Break the line of sight with foliage, go prone, keep still under a drone.
intel.guide_s.2: Once spotted, change direction: they aim where you should be, not where you were.
intel.guide_s.3: Watch the Mavic light. Red: you are watched. Fast red blink: move, now.
intel.guide_s.4: A siren at your base means a strike is coming: get out of the base.
intel.guide_s.5: Kill the saboteur before he reaches the generator.

e404.title: Signal lost
e404.p: This frequency carries nothing. The address may be wrong, or the page has moved.
e404.hint: Tune in: drag, scroll or use the arrow keys. Follow the meter.
e404.msg: INDFORGE HQ to {cs}. The page “{path}” does not exist on this net.
e404.sos: Distress call received. Help is on its way: follow “Back to command”.
e404.joke.0: Reminder: a missing page is not lost, it is on an infiltration mission.
e404.joke.1: Last contact: the page followed a waypoint and never came back.
e404.joke.2: Engineers report: the bridge to this page is down. Detour above.
e404.joke.3: The FOB cook swears it was still here this morning.
e404.joke.4: Good listening, operator. SIGINT could not have done better.
e404.joke.5: Standing order: never turn the radio dial at random. Ah, too late.
m.conflict-pve.tag: Co-op PvE Conflict on Everon: US players against an enemy that thinks.
m.conflict-pve.intro.0: INDFORGE - Conflict PvE turns the Conflict mode into a cooperative PvE campaign on Everon. Players fight as the US; the USSR and the FIA are run by AI with a combat doctrine, a headquarters that acts on intelligence, mortars, drones and helicopters.
m.conflict-pve.intro.1: Built on Gramps303's ConflictPVERemixedVanilla2.0 and on the WCS, RHS and ACE suites: over 100 Workshop mods, all declared dependencies, nothing repacked. For intermediate to advanced players who enjoy tactical team play. Lone wolves might shed a little tear.
m.conflict-pve.f.0: Enemy headquarters. Hunter groups only come on intelligence: an enemy drone or a patrol that spots you or your vehicle. They head where you should be by now, search the area, march in column and spread into a line on contact.
m.conflict-pve.f.1: Generator capture (with Enhanced Compositions). Repair the FIA HQ generator with a wrench, then fill it with fuel (18 L, about 20 s) while the base siren sounds. Radio contact with your HQ is required.
m.conflict-pve.f.2: Fuel economy. A running generator gives its base 10 supplies per litre, never more than the base storage holds. A friendly fuel depot or the deployable M1091 fuel truck keeps it full.
m.conflict-pve.f.3: Sabotage and breaching. About 30 s after a capture, the nearest enemy soldier tries to disable the generator. Wall it in with HESCO and a breacher blows the closest wall: kill him or defuse the charges within 20 s.
m.conflict-pve.f.4: Hard HESCO. Bullets, grenades and vehicles do nothing. Explosives only: 1, 2 or 4 M112 charges depending on size.
m.conflict-pve.f.6: AI doctrine. Fire discipline, tactical withdrawal, engagement ranges based on posture, movement, weather and night.
m.conflict-pve.f.7: Enemy mortars with forward observers, real ballistics and counter-battery play.
m.conflict-pve.f.8: Overwatch sniper teams: a Spetsnaz sniper with a spotter, or alone.
m.conflict-pve.f.9: Drone warfare. Enemy drones you can hide from (posture, foliage), jammers, drones kept in saved loadouts.
m.conflict-pve.f.10: Hunter squads and helicopter paratroopers sized by the number of nearby players.
m.conflict-pve.f.11: AI rocket launchers also target infantry, in every faction: stay spread out.
m.conflict-pve.f.12: Modern US AI in MultiCam; enemies with matching camouflage and red armbands; Spetsnaz paratroopers in black and A-TACS.
m.conflict-pve.f.13: C-RAM that engages all threats, with an attack siren (Main Base only).
m.conflict-pve.f.14: Ranks saved across server and mission restarts.
m.conflict-pve.f.15: Complete US arsenal: items from our mods that WCS leaves out are back. Arsenal and loadouts unlocked at every rank, except the Golden Shovel (Sergeant).
m.conflict-pve.f.16: The shovel cuts trees, not just bushes, and stumps are removed.
m.conflict-pve.f.17: Ally markers: icons above allies (50 m, 300 m through optics), squad members in team colour, names up close.
m.conflict-pve.f.18: Consistent garage and helipad costs: a better vehicle never costs less in supplies, XP or rank.
m.conflict-pve.f.19: Patrol trucks run either a supply run or a troop transport.
m.conflict-pve.new.0: Server freezes fixed: AI now spawn within a budget around each player, vehicles drive smoothly again.
m.conflict-pve.new.1: Enemy HQ: attack plans, road ambushes (mines, bait wrecks, FPV), roadblocks, mortar recon-strikes, glide bombs, cruise missiles, Geran raids, Su-57 flybys chased by F-22.
m.conflict-pve.new.2: Radio alerts from your HQ on the AN/PRC-152: drones, mortars, ambushes, Geran, jets.
m.conflict-pve.new.3: Ukrainian-front weather: 21 episodes, lightning and rolling thunder, full moon, Game Master buttons. The enemy adapts.
m.conflict-pve.new.4: Radar/Jammer truck, FP-1 drone truck with live camera, stronger M923A1 and FMTV trucks.
m.conflict-pve.new.5: Enemy night vision and thermal scopes, FIA in Vz95, no more slowdown in bushes.
m.conflict-pve.admin.0: Our systems are set from $profile:INDFORGE_*/config.json files: AI doctrine, enemy HQ, mortars, generator capture, hunter size, drone sight, name tags, patrol trucks, shovel, session report, and more. The admin console lists every key with its help text.
m.conflict-pve.admin.1: Third-party systems keep their own files: $profile:CET/CETConfig.json (hunters), $profile:MBS_AutoHeliSpawner/config.json (helicopters), $profile:EnhancedCompositions/Garrison.json (garrisons, to switch on).
m.conflict-pve.admin.2: The server runs the version published on the Workshop: an update arrives only after it is republished.

m.forest.tag: Conflict PvE in the dense forests of Belleau Wood.
m.forest.intro.0: INDFORGE - Forest is “Conflict” co-op PvE in the forests of Belleau Wood: US players versus USSR/FIA AI. The full INDFORGE - Conflict PvE experience, with its own bases, relay stations, roadblocks, patrols and vehicle spawn points. Under active development.
m.forest.intro.1: For intermediate to advanced players who enjoy tactical team play. Lone wolves might shed a little tear…
m.forest.intro.2: It requires INDFORGE - Conflict PvE. A change made in Conflict PvE reaches Forest once Conflict PvE is republished on the Workshop.
m.forest.f.0: Conflict bases, relay stations and starting points adapted to Belleau Wood.
m.forest.f.1: 15 forest roadblock setups with their guards.
m.forest.f.2: Every capturable base defended by 3 to 4 groups: rifle squad, machine-gun team, fire team, AT team.
m.forest.f.3: Spetsnaz Overwatch snipers, teams and lone snipers, tracking prey in open fields around the bases.
m.forest.f.4: Foot patrols between bases, armed and transport vehicle patrols, civilian presence.
m.forest.f.5: AI spawn points named after what they really spawn, for easier admin and editing.
m.forest.f.6: Random weapon caches: switched off on this map for now, coming soon.
m.forest.new.0: Up to date with INDFORGE - Conflict PvE 2.1.0: everything new in Conflict PvE now comes to Belleau Wood.
m.forest.new.1: Server freezes fixed: AI spawn within a budget around each player.
m.forest.new.2: Enemy HQ: attack plans, road ambushes, roadblocks, mortar recon-strikes, air strikes, Geran raids.

m.forest.admin.1: Set game.scenarioId to the scenario ID above and use the full mods block below: Forest, Conflict PvE and its dependencies, Belleau Wood and the two railway mods.

m.ai-framework.tag: Modular, map-agnostic AI for PvE scenarios: combat helicopters, garrisons, map markers. In development, not released yet.
m.ai-framework.intro.0: INDFORGE - AI Framework is in development and not published on the Workshop yet. It will add combat helicopter patrols, military garrisons on points of interest and player map markers to compatible Conflict scenarios.
m.ai-framework.intro.1: Everything will be set from a single config.json in the server profile, without touching the code. Each setting has its help key, the same name with a leading _, that explains it.
m.ai-framework.intro.2: Next steps: test in game, with players, the helicopter near the garrisons and a killed player's marker. Then: troop drops from the helicopter, still at the design stage.
m.ai-framework.f.0: Mi-8MT combat helicopters (three armed variants). A hostile helicopter appears near the largest group of players, anchored on a point of interest, with a full AI crew and an adjustable AI skill, from Noob to Expert. It flies with the studio's physics flight controller, not the engine's AI flight: patrol loop, altitude hold, banked turns. Status: the fault that kept it from appearing is fixed. The garrisons took every AI slot of the engine, so the crew could never board. On the dedicated-server test bench, with garrisons on, the crew boards in under 2 seconds and the helicopter flies its patrol. Not yet tested in game with players.
m.ai-framework.f.1: Automatic cleanup. Shot down, pilot or rotor lost, landed or in water: the wreck despawns and the slot is released after a cooldown (23 minutes in total with the reference file values).
m.ai-framework.f.2: Military garrisons. Each eligible point of interest gets two patrols, one tight and one wide, and small teams hold towers, bunkers and watchtowers. A base the players have just taken faces a counter-attack. Status: coded, not re-tested in game since 3 November 2026.
m.ai-framework.f.3: Player map markers. Every player of your faction is shown on the map (the base game shows them to the squad leader only), tinted when unconscious or dead. Your own position is an arrow in your faction colour, turned to your heading. A killed player stays grey where they fell until they respawn (server setting KeepDeadMarkerUntilRespawn). Each player sets in their own file whether they see their arrow, its size, its rotation and the colours. Status: done; it compiles and loads on the dedicated-server test bench. The map display can only be checked in game: not yet tested with players.
m.ai-framework.f.4: Reserve under the AI cap. The engine keeps at most 128 AI active at once. Garrisons and counter-attacks leave free slots for the helicopter crew (setting AIBudgetReserve, 12 by default, 0 = no reserve): when the reserve is reached, a patrol waits for a free slot and a counter-attack wave is skipped. On the bench, the total stays at 116 to 119 AI out of 128.
m.ai-framework.setup.0: The mod is not published yet: the full setup guide will come with its release.
m.ai-framework.setup.1: Settings will be read from $profile:INDF_CombatHeliSpawner/config.json, a copy of the shipped ServerProfile/INDF_CombatHeliSpawner/config.json. It is read once, at startup: restart the server (or Workbench) after every change.
m.ai-framework.setup.2: Keys starting with _ are help texts: the mod never reads them. Only edit the values.
m.ai-framework.admin.0: Do not raise MaxActiveHelicopters: the flight is scripted and has no collision avoidance between aircraft.
m.ai-framework.admin.1: At startup the log must show [INDF_CombatHeliConfig] LoadFromFile SUCCESS, then the POI scan and the garrison population.
m.ai-framework.admin.2: No helicopter? Check the player count (MinimumPlayersToActivate), the 23-minute wait after a destruction, and that AIBudgetReserve covers the crew (4 AI while it boards) plus one garrison squad.
m.enhanced-compositions.tag: Compact Conflict compositions, generator capture and AI garrisons.
m.enhanced-compositions.intro.0: Enhanced Compositions gives mission makers, Game Masters and players simpler Conflict compositions, easy to adapt to missions or maps where the Conflict mod is hard to set up, plus a new way to capture bases and AI garrisons that protect buildings.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.0: Compositions: small antenna, ammo storage (WIP), field hospital (WIP), vehicle maintenance and living area for US and USSR, the living area with the full list of AI groups in its menu; small FIA headquarters, tent and hut, each with or without a generator.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.1: FIA HQ generator. Starts out of order and dry, cannot be destroyed. Repair it with a wrench (8 s, any faction), fill it with a jerry can: it runs until the tank is empty. A crate in each generator HQ holds a wrench and a jerry can.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.2: Commander actions grouped on the HQ table, next to the construction panel: logistics, combat support and construction.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.3: Garrisons. Barracks: 5 soldiers patrolling plus the full unit list. Armory, vehicle workshops and fuel depot: a two-person team. Antenna: a two-person recon team.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.4: Garrison rules. The first group is free. A wiped group returns after 10 minutes if supplies allow and no enemy is near. Not recruitable, not saved. Corporals and above switch it with the Garrison action.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.5: Vehicle service while a guard lives: the fuel depot refuels allied vehicles for free; the workshops repair and rearm them for supplies.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.6: Golden Shovel in the US and USSR arsenals, from the rank of Sergeant.
m.enhanced-compositions.f.7: With INDFORGE - Conflict PvE only: capture by fuel, supplies from the generator and enemy sabotage.
m.enhanced-compositions.admin.1: The file is created on first launch with "Enabled": false: set it to true to turn garrisons on. The mod never overwrites it.
m.auc-factions.tag: Ukrainian, Russian and assault-battalion factions for the Arma Ukraine Community.
m.auc-factions.intro.0: AUC - Factions is a specific configuration of the WCS NATO and RU factions, and a little more, for the PvPvE servers of the [AUC] Arma Ukraine Community. It builds on these mods for stability and immersive gameplay.
m.auc-factions.f.0: BLUFOR: you play as the Ukrainian armed forces.
m.auc-factions.f.1: OPFOR: you play as the 214th Independent Assault Battalion, the only battalion authorised to play as enemy forces.
m.auc-factions.f.2: INDFOR: you fight the Russian armed forces.
m.auc-factions.f.3: Brings in, as dependencies, Realistic Combat Drones - WCS and kuka's Vampire UAV and FPV drones.
m.auc-factions.credits: Thanks to the WCS and RHS teams, SalamiBoiDev, FriendlyModder and kuka-.
m.auc-vehicles.tag: The vehicle pool of the Arma Ukraine Community servers.
m.auc-vehicles.intro.0: AUC - Vehicles is a specific configuration of several vehicle mods, with a few additional changes, built for the [AUC] Arma Ukraine Community.
m.auc-vehicles.credits: Thanks to the WCS, RHS, CIE and FRM teams and to every vehicle creator in the dependencies.
m.auc-conflict.tag: PvPvE Conflict for the Arma Ukraine Community, starting on Kolguyev.
m.auc-conflict.intro.0: AUC - Conflict is a specific configuration of the Conflict mode for the [AUC] Arma Ukraine Community. It relies on WCS_Core for stability and suits several kinds of terrain.
m.cherchetoi-rp-clothing.tag: Role-play clothing for the CHERCHETOI - RP LIFE community.
m.cherchetoi-rp-clothing.intro.0: ChercheToi RP - Clothing is a specific configuration of several clothing mods, with a few changes, for the CHERCHETOI - RP LIFE role-play community.
m.cherchetoi-rp-clothing.f.0: Civilian, biker and press outfits gathered from the clothing mods in the dependencies.
m.cherchetoi-rp-clothing.f.1: SAMU emergency-medical equipment, by CTRP team contributor Captain Valaaks.
m.cherchetoi-rp-props.tag: Role-play props for the CHERCHETOI - RP LIFE community.
m.cherchetoi-rp-props.intro.0: ChercheToi RP - Props is a specific configuration of props for the CHERCHETOI - RP LIFE community, built on Lakes Dan's work for the Faircroft Islands.
m.cherchetoi-rp-props.f.0: Props from Faircroft Islands and Brit Props by Lakes Dan.
m.cherchetoi-rp-props.f.1: Palm trees from Palmtree by Ben.obj.
m.cherchetoi-rp-vehicles.tag: The role-play vehicle pool of the CHERCHETOI - RP LIFE community.
m.cherchetoi-rp-vehicles.intro.0: ChercheToi RP - Vehicles is a specific configuration of 32 vehicle and equipment mods, with a few changes, for the CHERCHETOI - RP LIFE role-play community.
m.cherchetoi-rp-vehicles.f.0: Cars, SUVs, vans, a bus, pickups, motorbikes, bicycles, karts and boats from the community's favourite vehicle mods.
m.cherchetoi-rp-vehicles.f.1: Trucks such as the KamAZ 5350, and the SA342 Gazelle helicopter.
m.lav-25-desert.tag: The LAV-25 Piranha in Operation Desert Storm colours.
m.lav-25-desert.intro.0: The LAV-25 Piranha is a light armoured vehicle developed in 1981–1982 by General Motors Canada. It entered service with the United States Marine Corps in 1983, with 758 units delivered.
m.lav-25-desert.intro.1: Armed with an M242 Bushmaster 25 mm cannon and a coaxial M240 machine gun, it comes here in the four colours used during Operation Desert Storm, on 17 January 1991. A thought for the veterans of that war.
m.lav-25-desert.f.0: LAV-25 (MC) in four Desert Storm colour schemes.
m.lav-25-desert.f.1: M242 Bushmaster 25 mm cannon and coaxial M240.
m.modern-fia.tag: A modernised FIA: bullpup rifle, ballistic helmets, body armour.
m.modern-fia.intro.0: As part of a programme to modernise its infantry, the Freedom and Independence Army (FIA) receives new equipment.
m.modern-fia.f.0: Promet bullpup assault rifle in 6.5×39 mm, 30-round magazine.
m.rcd-rhs.tag: SalamiBoiDev's drones and jammer backpack in every RHS arsenal.
m.rcd-rhs.intro.0: Realistic Combat Drones - RHS adds the full set of SalamiBoiDev's drone equipment to the RHS arsenals.
m.rcd-rhs.f.0: FPV drones, dropper drones and recon drones, each with its battery.
m.rcd-rhs.f.3: In the FFA, ION, RHS MSV and USMC arsenals.
m.rcd-wcs.tag: SalamiBoiDev's drones in the WCS arsenals, and a buildable TPN-19 jammer.
m.rcd-wcs.intro.0: Realistic Combat Drones - WCS adds the full set of SalamiBoiDev's drone equipment to the WCS arsenals of the US (BLUFOR) and the USSR (OPFOR), with costs and ranks, plus a drone jammer you can build in Conflict bases.
m.rcd-wcs.f.0: FPV-RPG drone (125), FPV drone (100), dropper drone (75), recon drone (50), batteries (2), controller and goggles (0): Corporal.
m.rcd-wcs.f.1: Jammer bag (100): Private. Long-range drone antenna (200): Sergeant. Drone command station (300): Lieutenant.
m.rcd-wcs.f.2: TPN-19 radar jammer, buildable in Conflict bases by US, USSR or FIA (cost 300): jams drones within 250 m as soon as it is built. ON/OFF switch on the side door handle, usable by anyone. Generator sounds follow its state. Also available to Game Masters.
m.rcd-wcs.f.3: Friend or foe: a jammer worn, carried or built into a base no longer cuts the drones of its own side and allies. A jammer left on the ground jams everyone.
m.rcd-wcs.f.4: Drone controller in the secondary weapon slot; a mask can be worn with drone goggles.
m.solo-push-pull.tag: Push or pull any car or truck on your own. Even the BTR.
m.solo-push-pull.intro.0: A simple change to the vanilla unflip action that came with Arma Reforger 1.2.0.92: now, even alone, you can push or pull any car or truck, and even the BTR, like a real superhero.
m.solo-push-pull.intro.1: Compatible with all mods. Caution: an overdose of Push-Pull may cause health problems.
m.solo-push-pull.f.0: Solo push and pull on cars, trucks and armoured vehicles.
m.solo-push-pull.f.1: No dependency, compatible with all mods.
m.solo-push-pull.credits: A big thank you to the Conflict In Europe team [CIE] for putting this mod in the spotlight.
m.talibanmod-red-side-v2.tag: FIA and USSR turned into insurgents of the Arab world, for Task Force Baguette.
m.talibanmod-red-side-v2.intro.0: TalibanMod Red Side V2, made for Task Force Baguette, turns the FIA and the USSR into OPFOR fighters from various rebellions of the Arab world. PvE Conflict available.
m.talibanmod-red-side-v2.f.3: Arabic inscriptions on FIA and USSR signs.
m.talibanmod-red-side-v2.credits: Thanks to V-lst for Insurgents SAF and to zelik for Zeliks Character.
m.off-road-vehicles.tag: Off-road 4×4 and 6×6 vehicles for limitless exploration.
m.off-road-vehicles.intro.0: Off-Road Vehicles brings several 4×4 and 6×6 vehicles to discover Everon like never before, with a Game Master scenario to try them.
m.off-road-vehicles.intro.1: On standby: the mod may be merged with UAZ-452 Offroad.
m.off-road-vehicles.f.0: 4×4 and 6×6 vehicles in six colours: blue, grey, orange, savanna, snow, suburban.
m.off-road-vehicles.f.1: A repair and medical assistance version.
m.off-road-vehicles.f.3: Tip: if forward gear is not enough, reverse has more torque.
m.uaz-452-offroad.tag: The UAZ-452 "Bukhanka", reworked for the mountains.
m.uaz-452-offroad.intro.0: The UAZ-452 Classic is an off-road van built at the Ulyanovsk plant since 1965. We reworked its design to make a real Bukhanka ready to take on the mountains: 110 hp and more to take you beyond the horizon.
m.uaz-452-offroad.intro.1: On standby: the mod may be merged with Off-Road Vehicles.
m.uaz-452-offroad.f.0: Civilian 4×4 in eight colours: khaki, red, yellow, green, blue, dark blue, purple, pink.
m.uaz-452-offroad.f.1: Repair version for the Civilian, FIA and USSR factions.

about.giants: We move forward “on the shoulders of giants”: our creations build on the work of other creators and depend on it; nothing is repacked. But we don't stop there: some of our work is strong enough to stand on its own, without depending on anything else… Either way, pooling our efforts is and will remain an exceptional and deeply rewarding adventure for our team.
wip.d: These projects are done: they are in Conflict PvE {v}, published on the Workshop on {d}.
wip.perf_p: The freezes that made vehicles stutter and drift when many AI were around are fixed. Patrols, base garrisons and counter-attacks now spawn at a shorter distance, never too close to a player, spread out in time, within a budget of AI soldiers around each player, larger for a group. Far counter-attacks sleep when the whole map is full and wake up when you come close: an enemy recapture is delayed, never blocked. Settings: $profile:INDFORGE_AIBudget/config.json.
wip.wx_p: 21 episodes by day and by night (clear, still night, mist, low stratus, drizzle, showers, rain, grey front, dry thunder, thunderstorm, night storm, fog banks…), with smooth transitions. Harmless lightning, thunder that arrives at the speed of sound, a full moon every night, a Weather tab for the Game Master. The enemy adapts: drones grounded in strong wind, heavy rain or fog.
ew.name: Bigfoot - Radar/Jammer
ew.p: A “Bigfoot” truck from the large garage turned into an electronic warfare vehicle: it deploys a radar or a jammer, and runs on a diesel generator.
ew.done.0: Radar: once deployed, it marks moving enemies on the map.
ew.done.1: Jammer: once deployed, it cuts enemy drones.
ew.done.2: Cable link with the FP-1 drone launcher truck: the radar's targets show live in the FP-1 mission planner.
ew.done.3: Enemy direction finding: a radar or jammer that emits too long gets located, then struck (mortar, glide bomb, Geran, sapper raid or FPV).
ew.done.4: Radio alerts: with an AN/PRC-152 radio, your HQ also warns you of radar contacts and enemy direction finding.
ew.done.5: M923A1 trucks: stronger engine, gearbox and locking differentials on every US variant, about 70 to 76 km/h, better off road.
ew.done.6: Server settings: new file $profile:INDFORGE_RadarTruck/config.json, see the Admins page.
ew.written_h: Written, not compiled or tested yet
ew.insp: Inspiration: modern AESA radars that double as radar and jammer (sector of about 120°, jamming costs power and heat).

tips.title: Tips
tips.lead: Toutes les fonctionnalités de nos mods, classées par mod, et la façon de s'en servir. Cochez les fiches que vous maîtrisez pour monter en grade : votre progression reste sur votre appareil.
tips.r.m_d: Game Master et créateurs de missions
tips.note: Les fiches marquées À venir sont intégrées en développement et arrivent avec la prochaine mise à jour Workshop de Conflict PvE.
tips.packs_d: Factions, véhicules et équipements prêts à l'emploi.
tips.cp-base.s.0: Gardez la liaison radio avec votre QG : sans elle, le plein ne compte pas.
tips.cp-base.s.1: Réparez le générateur du QG FIA avec une clé (8 s).
tips.cp-base.s.2: Versez-y 18 L de carburant (environ 20 s) en restant à côté. La sirène de la base sonne pendant le plein.
tips.cp-base.s.3: Plein terminé : la base est à vous, tout de suite.
tips.cp-base.x: Rester dans la zone ne prend plus une base à générateur. Une caisse dans chaque QG à générateur contient une clé et un jerrican.
tips.cp-fuel.s.0: Une base à générateur démarre sans ravitaillement : tout vient du générateur.
tips.cp-fuel.s.1: En marche, il donne à sa base 10 ravitaillements par litre brûlé, jamais plus que ce que le stock de la base peut contenir.
tips.cp-fuel.s.2: Un dépôt de carburant allié, ou le camion-citerne M1091 déployé près du générateur, le garde plein.
tips.cp-fuel.s.3: Réservoir vide : le ravitaillement s'arrête, mais la base reste à vous.
tips.cp-fuel.x: Le M1091 de l'arsenal US se déploie en station de carburant. Le petit réservoir de carburant fonctionne aussi.
tips.cp-sabot.s.0: Environ 30 s après votre prise, le soldat ennemi le plus proche marche vers le générateur.
tips.cp-sabot.s.1: Il lui faut 8 s à la clé pour le mettre en panne : la base repasse à l'ennemi et la sirène sonne.
tips.cp-sabot.s.2: Tuez-le avant. S'il tombe, le suivant le plus proche prend le relais.
tips.cp-sabot.x: Un générateur saboté garde son carburant : une simple réparation suffit pour reprendre la base.
tips.cp-hesco.s.0: Les HESCO ne craignent ni les balles, ni les grenades, ni les véhicules.
tips.cp-hesco.s.1: Seuls les explosifs les détruisent : 1, 2 ou 4 charges M112 selon leur taille.
tips.cp-hesco.s.2: Générateur emmuré : un brècheur ennemi pose des charges sur le mur le plus proche.
tips.cp-hesco.s.3: Minuterie de 20 s : tuez-le ou désamorcez les charges.
tips.cp-drone.s.0: Un drone vous voit à moins de 300 m debout, 180 m accroupi, 100 m couché.
tips.cp-drone.s.1: Restez immobile : ces portées baissent de 30 %. La nuit et la météo les réduisent encore.
tips.cp-drone.s.2: Mettez du feuillage entre vous et le drone, même le buisson où vous êtes. Sous 15 m, c'est le test du drone lui-même qui s'applique.
tips.cp-drone.s.3: Perdus de vue, ils vous cherchent environ deux minutes là où ils vous ont vus en dernier : éloignez-vous.
tips.cp-jam.s.0: Le sac brouilleur démarre éteint : allumez-le avec son action marche/arrêt.
tips.cp-jam.s.1: Allumé, il arrête les drones FPV dans un rayon de 50 m.
tips.cp-jam.s.2: Le brouilleur radar TPN-19 construit dans une base a le même interrupteur, sur son côté.
tips.cp-hq.s.0: Les chasseurs ne viennent que sur renseignement : un drone ou une patrouille ennemie qui vous repère, vous ou votre véhicule.
tips.cp-hq.s.1: Avec deux rapports, l'ennemi calcule votre direction et votre vitesse : il va là où vous devriez être maintenant.
tips.cp-hq.s.2: Une fois repérés, changez de direction.
tips.cp-hq.s.3: Les groupes de chasseurs et les parachutistes grossissent avec le nombre de joueurs proches.
tips.cp-mortar.s.0: Pas de mortier sans observateur : un chef de groupe ou un drone de reconnaissance doit vous voir, et vous devez rester sur place assez longtemps.
tips.cp-mortar.s.1: D'abord les coups de réglage, puis le tir d'efficacité : au premier impact, bougez.
tips.cp-mortar.s.2: Tuez l'observateur ou cassez sa vue.
tips.cp-mortar.s.3: Contre-batterie : les batteries, installées dans une base ennemie de 900 m à 3,5 km de la cible, peuvent être trouvées et détruites.
tips.cp-spread.s.0: Les lance-roquettes de l'IA visent aussi l'infanterie, dans toutes les factions.
tips.cp-spread.s.1: Un groupe serré se prend une seule roquette pour tous : gardez de l'espace entre vous.
tips.cp-doct.s.0: Un groupe qui vous repère avant que vous ne le voyiez retient son feu et approche.
tips.cp-doct.s.1: Pris au dépourvu, la moitié du groupe recule en tirant pendant que l'autre court vers un couvert, puis ils reviennent.
tips.cp-doct.s.2: Leur portée de tir dépend de votre posture et de vos mouvements. Dès que vous tirez, vous perdez l'avantage de votre posture.
tips.cp-mark.s.0: Une icône s'affiche au-dessus des alliés jusqu'à 50 m, et jusqu'à 300 m à travers une optique.
tips.cp-mark.s.1: Les membres de votre groupe prennent la couleur de leur équipe.
tips.cp-shovel.h: Abattre un arbre à la pelle
tips.cp-shovel.s.0: La pelle coupe aussi les arbres, pas seulement les buissons.
tips.cp-rank.s.0: L'arsenal US complet est ouvert à tous les grades, sauf la pelle dorée (sergent).
tips.cp-rank.s.1: Vos grades sont gardés après un redémarrage du serveur ou de la mission.
tips.cp-rank.s.2: Garage et héliport : un meilleur véhicule ne coûte jamais moins cher en ravitaillement, en XP ou en grade.
tips.cp-cram.s.0: Le C-RAM de la base principale engage toutes les menaces.
tips.cp-cram.s.1: Il est accompagné d'une sirène d'attaque.
tips.cp-mavic.s.0: Vert : en patrouille, rien de repéré.
tips.cp-mavic.s.1: Rouge : il suit une cible. Vous êtes observés.
tips.cp-mavic.s.2: Rouge clignotant rapide : il guide une bombe planante. Bougez, tout de suite.
tips.cp-mavic.s.3: Orange clignotant : il fouille là où il vous a perdus.
tips.cp-mavic.x: Jamais de feu sur un FPV. Abattez le Mavic ou cassez sa vue.
tips.cp-wx.s.0: Les drones ennemis restent au sol dès 10 m/s de vent, sous une forte pluie ou dans un brouillard épais.
tips.cp-wx.s.1: Les largages et vagues d'hélicoptères s'arrêtent dès 14 m/s, les parachutistes dès 8 m/s.
tips.cp-wx.s.2: Le brouillard et la pluie raccourcissent la vue des observateurs de mortier. La thermique voit à travers un brouillard léger.
tips.cp-ambush.s.0: L'ennemi suit la route devant votre véhicule et pose une zone de destruction 400 à 600 m plus loin, du côté le plus haut.
tips.cp-ambush.s.1: Personne ne tire avant que vous n'entriez dans la zone : la première roquette, puis tout le monde.
tips.cp-ambush.s.2: Des barrages persistants apparaissent sur les routes goudronnées que vous empruntez le plus et changent de place tous les deux jours environ : variez vos itinéraires.
tips.cp-air.s.0: Une bombe planante vise des joueurs à pied qu'un Mavic garde en vue : son feu rouge clignote vite.
tips.cp-air.s.1: Une sirène sur une base que vous venez de prendre annonce un missile de croisière : sortez de la base.
tips.cp-air.s.2: Les Geran partent de camions lanceurs garés sur des routes à plusieurs kilomètres : détruisez le camion ou tuez son chauffeur, et le raid s'arrête.
tips.cp-air.s.3: Jamais sur la base principale d'une faction, jamais quand la météo cloue les aéronefs au sol.
tips.cp-radio.s.0: De courts messages préviennent les joueurs concernés : drone au-dessus, groupe d'interception en route, mortier, Geran, missile, avion, embuscade.
tips.cp-radio.s.1: Ils ne donnent jamais la position exacte de l'ennemi.
tips.cp-vol.h: Régler le volume des alertes radio
tips.cp-vol.s.0: Les appels radio du QG (alertes drone, mortier, embuscade, interception…) sont trop forts ? Baissez le curseur « Chat vocal » dans Réglages > Audio.
tips.cp-vol.s.1: Ils passent par la radio, comme la voix d'un joueur. Le curseur « Dialogues » ne les change pas.
tips.cp-night.s.0: Certains soldats ennemis portent des jumelles de vision nocturne, plus souvent les tireurs d'élite et les forces spéciales.
tips.cp-night.s.1: Ce qu'un soldat voit dépend de ce qu'il porte : œil nu, vision nocturne ou lunette thermique. Certains drones ennemis ont une caméra thermique.
tips.cp-night.x: La nuit ne vous cache pas de tout le monde.
tips.cp-cmd.s.0: Tapez les commandes dans la discussion en jeu avec le rôle d'administrateur du serveur ou de session, ou envoyez-les par RCON. La réponse revient dans la discussion.
tips.cp-cmd.s.1: #setrank <nom du joueur> <grade> : donne un grade, gardé après un redémarrage.
tips.cp-cmd.s.2: #aidoctrine status et #enemyhq status : l'état de la doctrine de l'IA et de l'état-major ennemi.
tips.cp-cmd.s.3: #aidoctrine mod <nom> <facteur> [secondes] : multiplie les portées d'engagement, sans redémarrer.
tips.cp-cfg.s.0: Nos systèmes se règlent dans les fichiers $profile:INDFORGE_*/config.json du profil du serveur.
tips.cp-cfg.s.1: Un fichier absent est créé avec ses valeurs par défaut au démarrage. Un fichier existant n'est jamais écrasé.
tips.cp-cfg.s.2: Les systèmes tiers gardent leurs fichiers : $profile:CET/CETConfig.json (chasseurs), $profile:MBS_AutoHeliSpawner/config.json (hélicoptères), $profile:EnhancedCompositions/Garrison.json (garnisons).
tips.cp-cfg.s.3: Le serveur tourne sur la version publiée sur le Workshop : une mise à jour n'arrive qu'après sa republication.
tips.cp-logs.s.0: Cherchez INDFORGE enemy HQ: pour les pistes, groupes, plans et frappes, avec un bilan toutes les 5 minutes.
tips.cp-logs.s.1: INDFORGE AI doctrine: au démarrage, à chaque changement de météo et toutes les 5 minutes.
tips.cp-logs.s.2: INDFORGE generator capture:, INDFORGE generator breach: et INDFORGE fuel truck: pour la capture des bases.
tips.fo-same.s.0: Même IA, même doctrine, même arsenal, mêmes grades et mêmes réglages que sur Everon.
tips.fo-same.s.1: Toutes les fiches Conflict PvE ci-dessus valent aussi à Belleau Wood.
tips.fo-base.s.0: Chaque base à prendre est défendue par 3 à 4 groupes : escouade de fusiliers, équipe de mitrailleuse, équipe de feu, équipe antichar.
tips.fo-base.s.1: Ne venez pas en véhicule léger jusqu'aux murs : l'équipe antichar vous attend.
tips.fo-snipe.s.0: Des tireurs d'élite Spetsnaz Overwatch, en équipe ou seuls, traquent leurs proies dans les champs autour des bases.
tips.fo-snipe.s.1: Traversez vite les espaces ouverts et longez les lisières.
tips.fo-road.s.0: 15 barrages forestiers sont tenus par leurs gardes.
tips.fo-road.s.1: Des patrouilles à pied circulent entre les bases, avec des véhicules armés et de transport.
tips.fo-adm.s.0: Mettez l'ID de scénario de Forest dans game.scenarioId.
tips.fo-adm.s.1: Prenez le bloc de mods complet de la fiche du mod : Forest, Conflict PvE et ses dépendances, Belleau Wood et les deux mods ferroviaires.
tips.fo-adm.s.2: Mêmes fichiers de profil et mêmes commandes que Conflict PvE.
tips.ec-gen.s.0: Le générateur du QG FIA démarre en panne et à sec. Il est indestructible.
tips.ec-gen.s.1: Réparez-le avec une clé : 8 s, toutes factions.
tips.ec-gen.s.2: Remplissez-le avec un jerrican : il tourne jusqu'à ce que le réservoir soit vide.
tips.ec-gen.x: Une caisse dans chaque QG à générateur contient une clé et un jerrican.
tips.ec-cmd.h: Commander depuis la table du QG
tips.ec-cmd.s.0: Les actions du commandant sont regroupées sur la table du QG, à côté du panneau de construction.
tips.ec-cmd.s.1: Trois familles : logistique, appui au combat, construction.
tips.ec-gar.s.0: Caserne : une équipe de feu de 5 soldats patrouille autour du bâtiment.
tips.ec-gar.s.1: Armurerie, ateliers véhicules et dépôt de carburant : deux gardes postés. Antenne : un binôme de reconnaissance.
tips.ec-gar.s.2: La première garnison est gratuite. Un groupe anéanti revient après 10 minutes, payé en ravitaillement, si aucun ennemi n'est proche.
tips.ec-gar.s.3: Action Garnison sur le bâtiment pour la couper ou la rallumer, dès le grade de caporal.
tips.ec-gar.x: Les soldats de garnison ne se recrutent pas et ne sont pas sauvegardés.
tips.ec-svc.s.0: Tant qu'un garde est en vie, arrêtez-vous à côté du dépôt de carburant : il refait le plein de vos véhicules gratuitement.
tips.ec-svc.s.1: Les ateliers réparent et réarment vos véhicules, contre du ravitaillement.
tips.ec-gold.s.0: Dans les arsenaux US et USSR, dès le grade de sergent.
tips.ec-gold.s.1: Avec elle, vous construisez deux fois plus vite.
tips.ec-gm.s.0: Petites compositions Conflict : antenne, maintenance véhicules et zone de vie US et USSR, petit QG FIA, tente et cabane, avec ou sans générateur.
tips.ec-gm.s.1: La zone de vie donne la liste complète des groupes d'IA dans son menu.
tips.ec-gm.s.2: Pensées pour les cartes où le mode Conflict est difficile à monter.
tips.ec-adm.s.1: Le fichier est créé au premier lancement avec "Enabled": false : passez-le à true.
tips.rw-rank.s.0: Caporal : drone FPV-RPG (125), FPV (100), largueur (75), reconnaissance (50), batteries (2), contrôleur et lunettes (0).
tips.rw-rank.s.2: Sergent : antenne de drone longue portée (200). Lieutenant : station de commandement de drones (300).
tips.rw-tpn.s.0: Construisez-le dans une base Conflict, en US, USSR ou FIA, pour 300.
tips.rw-tpn.s.1: Il brouille les drones dans un rayon de 250 m dès qu'il est construit.
tips.rw-tpn.s.2: Interrupteur marche/arrêt sur la poignée de la porte latérale, utilisable par tous. Les bruits du générateur suivent son état.
tips.rw-tpn.x: Les Game Masters peuvent aussi le poser.
tips.rw-iff.h: Ne pas brouiller ses propres drones
tips.rw-iff.s.0: Porté, tenu ou construit dans une base, un brouilleur ne coupe plus les drones de son camp et de ses alliés.
tips.rw-iff.s.1: Posé au sol, il brouille tout le monde.
tips.rw-iff.x: Ne laissez pas traîner votre sac brouilleur près de vos pilotes.
tips.rw-kit.s.0: Le contrôleur de drone se range dans l'emplacement d'arme secondaire.
tips.rw-kit.s.1: Un masque se porte avec les lunettes de drone.
tips.rr-where.s.0: Drones FPV, largueurs et de reconnaissance, chacun avec sa batterie, plus le contrôleur, les lunettes et le sac brouilleur.
tips.rr-where.s.1: Dans les arsenaux FFA, ION, RHS MSV et USMC.
tips.sp-push.s.0: Approchez-vous d'une voiture, d'un camion ou même d'un BTR.
tips.sp-push.s.1: Utilisez l'action pour pousser ou retourner le véhicule : seul, vous y arrivez maintenant.
tips.sp-push.s.2: Compatible avec tous les mods, sans dépendance.
tips.sp-push.x: Une overdose de Push-Pull peut nuire à la santé.
tips.or-torque.s.0: Si la marche avant ne suffit pas, passez la marche arrière : elle a plus de couple.
tips.or-gm.s.0: Lancez le scénario Game Master Everon Explorer.
tips.or-gm.s.1: 4×4 et 6×6 en six couleurs, plus une version dépannage et assistance médicale.
tips.auf-side.s.0: BLUFOR : vous jouez les forces armées ukrainiennes.
tips.auf-side.s.1: OPFOR : vous jouez le 214e bataillon d'assaut indépendant.
tips.auf-side.s.2: INDFOR : vous combattez les forces armées russes.
tips.auv-rank.s.0: Les véhicules BLUFOR (65) et OPFOR (55) se débloquent avec les grades.
tips.auv-rank.s.1: INDFOR : 21 véhicules en camouflage RHS. Civils : 13 véhicules.
tips.ctrp.s.0: Clothing : tenues civiles, motard et presse, et l'équipement SAMU de Captain Valaaks.
tips.ctrp.s.1: Props : objets des îles Faircroft et Brit Props de Lakes Dan, palmiers de Ben.obj.
tips.ctrp.s.2: Vehicles : voitures, utilitaires, bus, motos, vélos, karts, bateaux, camions et l'hélicoptère SA342 Gazelle.
tips.mfia.s.0: Fusil d'assaut bullpup Promet en 6,5×39 mm, chargeur de 30 coups.
tips.mfia.s.1: Deux casques balistiques NIJ IIIA et un gilet pare-balles NIJ IV.
tips.tal.s.0: FIA et USSR deviennent des combattants de rébellions du monde arabe : personnages, gilets, coiffes, véhicules couleur sable.
tips.tal.s.1: Civils et véhicules civils de style arabe, inscriptions arabes sur les panneaux. Scénario Conflict en PvE disponible.
tips.lav.s.0: Quatre schémas de couleurs Tempête du désert.
tips.lav.s.1: Canon M242 Bushmaster de 25 mm et M240 coaxiale. Aucune dépendance.
tips.uaz.s.1: Version dépannage pour les factions Civil, FIA et USSR.
